## Changed

- **Requires Obsidian 1.5.8 or newer.** The checkbox styles rely on CSS masks, which are fully supported from that version on. If you use an older Obsidian, you keep version 1.2.1.
- Release files now come with a GitHub build attestation, so anyone can check that they were built from this repository.
- Small code and CSS cleanups from the Obsidian plugin review.
